Liturgical Calendar for October 2018

Note:  This is a liturgical calendar (ordo) for the month of October 2018 for the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass in the Extraordinary Form according to the Missale Romanum (1962) of Pope St. John XXIII.  This ordo is intended as a general guide.  It does not show feasts which are observed only in particular places or by particular congregations.  It does not show votive Masses on the days when they are permitted by the rubrics.  If a Mass is shown in this color, it means that Propers for that Mass are available on this site.

October 2018
Date Day The Mass Class Color Commemoration
1 Monday Feria 4 G St. Remigius
or: St. Remigius, Bishop & Confessor 4 W
2 Tuesday Holy Guardian Angels 3 W
3 Wednesday St. Theresa of the Infant Jesus, Virgin & Doctor 3 W
4 Thursday St. Francis of Assisi, Deacon & Confessor 3 W
5 Friday Feria 4 G St. Placid and Companions
or: St. Placid and Companions, Martyrs 4 R
6 Saturday St. Bruno, Confessor 3 W
7 Sunday Twentieth Sunday after Pentecost 2 G Our Lady of the Most Holy Rosary
or: Our Lady of the Most Holy Rosary 2 W Twentieth Sunday after Pentecost

9 Tuesday St. John Leonardi, Confessor 3 W St. Denis & Companions
10 Wednesday St. Francis Borgia, Confessor 3 W
11 Thursday The Maternity of the Blessed Virgin Mary 2 W
12 Friday Feria 4 G
13 Saturday St. Edward the Confessor, King 3 W

(or in Carmelite churches: Our Holy Mother St. Teresa, Virgin)
 3 W

22 Monday Feria 4 G
23 Tuesday St. Anthony Mary Claret, Bishop & Confessor 3 W
